title: The Mission
summary: With Dante in a shocked and vulnerable state after being tricked by the Professor, Lok leads the team into a final battle with the Professor as they try and prevent him from invoking the Legendary Titan of Immortality. But sacrifices have to be made...

sections.heading: Plot
sections.wikitext:
'''The Legendary Titans'''

Inside [[the Professor's castle]], [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] expresses his frustrations at [[Dante Vale|Dante]] for giving [[the Professor]] [[Tao]] and [[Behemoth]], but Dante is in a state of complete shock and can't react. The team decide to go on without him and plan to stall the ritual to invoke the [[Overlos|Legendary Titan of Immortality]] by distracting the [[Legendary Titans]]. However, [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] decides to stay with Dante as he's completely vulnerable to any threats, and sure enough, two statues in the room turn into [[Undergolem]] Titans, and Zhalia is left to fight them and protect Dante while Lok, [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] and [[Cherit]] go after the Professor.
[[File:S1E26 Lindorm Freelancer Hoplite Behemoth.png|thumb|[[Lok Lambert|Lok]]'s [[Titans]] are off to face [[Behemoth]]]]
In the invocation room, the Professor summons Behemoth, Tao and [[Araknos]] and begins the ritual to awaken the Legendary Titan from the [[Amulet of Will]]. Shortly after, the team arrives and the Professor reveals that invoking the Legendary Titan of Immortality, though indeed will cure [[Metz]], will also serve to give him immortality to dominate the world. Lok and Sophie decide to invoke their Titans as Araknos is busy with the ritual to control them, and start fighting the Professor, also interrupting his ritual. [[The Professor|Simon]] orders the Legendary Titans to attack them and focus their strength on Lok. Despite their best efforts, it's not long before most of Lok and Sophie's [[Titans]] are overpowered by the Legendary Titans. Tao then sends Lok flying through the wall, and Cherit is able to catch him. 

In the meanwhile, Zhalia is still fighting the Undergolems and notices that seemingly no [[Seekers|Seeker]] is there to control them. Sophie is then off to fight the Professor by herself, and is able to invoke [[Icarus]] and [[Sabriel]] after using [[Newlife]] on their [[amulets]]. Araknos is still able to control them with its webs; however, to the Professor's surprise, Sophie invokes [[Albion]], who is immune to mind control and is able to free Icarus and Sabriel from the webs. Simon then sends [[Behemoth]] and [[Tao]] after her. To his annoyance, Sophie and her Titans are able to further stall both Legendary Titans for the time being.

'''More Than Just a Titan'''

[[Lok Lambert|Lok]] then regains consciousness inside of the Professor's personal room, as Cherit had barely enough energy to drop him off through the window. Lok finds his dad's old [[Holotome]] in a desk, alongside the amulet of [[Dendras]], who is able to gain control of enemy Titans with the aid of [[Baselaird]]. Back in the invocation room, [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] is too weak to use any more powers, and [[Sabriel]] is her last Titan remaining. The Professor doesn't want to waste any more time and restarts the ritual. Sophie orders Sabriel to attack Simon but he invokes [[Nordrake]] and [[Dominator]]. [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] is still struggling against the enemy Titans while Dante is unconscious and is out of power to call any more Titans of her own. Still in the Professor's room, Lok has worked out a plan involving Dendras and Baselaird to hopefully save the day.
[[File:S1E26 Sophie Sabriel amulet dust.png|thumb|[[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] breaks down as [[Sabriel]]'s amulet fades into dust]]
Sophie and Sabriel struggle against the Professor's Titans as the latter is hit with Dominator's spikes, causing her to ignore orders and keep fighting, gradually taking hits and deteriorating while not being sent back to her amulet. Sabriel decides to attack the Professor directly, who strikes her with a sequence of spells that make Sabriel disappear, her [[Amulets|amulet]] being destroyed, seemingly for good. Sophie is angered after her Titan-friend is permanently destroyed, and uses [[Soulburn]] to gain energy to keep fighting at the cost of some of her life force.

'''Eathon Lambert's Fate'''

In the meanwhile, [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] is completely out of Titans and starts saying her goodbyes to [[Dante Vale|Dante]] as the two [[Undergolem|Undergolems]] move closer. However, Dante suddenly wakes up and invokes a spare [[Caliban]] to fight off the enemies. [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] again takes on the Professor and his Titans and is soon launched out of the hole Lok made when he was thrown against the wall, only to be caught by him with the use of [[Kipperin]]. They fly back to the invocation room and Lok starts to inquiry [[The Professor|Simon]] about [[Eathon Lambert|his father]]'s whereabouts, just as Dante invokes [[Metagolem]] to finish off the two enemy Titans. Afterwards, he and Zhalia find a [[Eathon the dog|dog named Eathon]] who, via a trained response set by [[Araknos]], invoked the Undergolems. The two then start heading to the invocation room.  
[[File:S1E26 Personal Guard Professor Eathon.png|thumb|[[The Professor]] corners [[Eathon Lambert|Eathon]] ten years in the past]]
[[The Professor]] answers Lok's questions and explains how he chased [[Eathon Lambert]] for years before finally cornering him by a waterfall in South America ten years ago; he continues by saying Eathon knew he could make him say anything he wanted with Araknos' ring, and that Eathon did not want to give up the information on the [[Amulet of Will]]; however, they were interrupted by the completion of the ritual to prepare the [[Amulet of Will]] to be used right before the Professor revealed what Eathon decided to do at the waterfall. Lok sees that he need to stop him from getting to the Amulet of Will, but he's quickly overpowered by the three Legendary Titans who are now free to fight back. He is then saved by Dante's Metagolem, who joins the fight alongside Zhalia. 

'''The Plan to Save the World'''
[[File:S1E26 Dendras Baselaird Kipperin Lok Overlos.png|thumb|[[Lok Lambert|Lok]]'s plan comes to fruition at the last second as he's able to control [[Overlos]]]]
[[Lok Lambert|Lok]] states that he has a plan to the team as the Professor invokes [[Overlos|Overlos, the Legendary Titan of Will]]. Lok then invokes [[Dendras]] and [[Baselaird]] while [[Dante Vale|Dante]] also invokes his respective [[Titans]], with Zhalia invoking [[Gar-Ghoul]], as she had taken the amulet for herself instead of giving it to a [[Huntik Foundation]] HQ. The team and their Titans work in unison to distract the Professor's Titans right as Baselaird joins forces with Dendras to control Overlos before [[the Professor]] can request immortality for himself. However, Overlos is seemingly immune to Dendras' ability, making Dante invoke Archwarder to successfully disrupt [[The Professor|Simon]]'s control of the Legendary Titan of Immortality. Lok, now having control of Overlos with Dendras, commands it to open a portal to the [[Spirit World]] and take the remaining Legendary Titans with it. Overlos does as ordered, but not before [[Araknos]] webs the Professor to also drag him to [[Spirit World|Huntik]]. Despite Lok and Dante's best efforts to save him, [[The Professor|Simon Judeau]] does get taken to the Spirit World as the portal closes up.

Two days later, the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team is back at [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]] and are surprised by clapping from various friends, including the newly cured [[Metz]], congratulating them for defeating [[the Professor]]. The team praise [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] while he wonders about [[Eathon Lambert|his father]]'s fate, hoping to find him. Nevertheless, summer vacation is almost over, and school starts next Monday for Lok and [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]].

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
*The original Italian of this episode is ''"E' nato un cercatore"'' (''A Seeker Is Born'' in Italian) which is the name of the first episode of the series in English.
*After giving his Caliban Amulet to the Professor in the episode prior, Dante reveals in this episode that he, in fact, always possessed two [[Caliban]] Titans. This is much more clear-cut in the Italian dub where Dante says this outright, while in the English dub he states "Good thing I always carry a spare".

full_text:
The Professor's castle, Prague

The Amulet of Will and Lok's father's diary are in the Professor's hands. In order to get them back, the Huntik team decides to face him once and for all in his private hideout. But the Professor's diabolical mind has no limits. After an arduous fight, he persuades Dante to turn his back on his friends and give him the three Legendary Titans.

== Synopsis ==

The team decide to go on without him and plan to stall the ritual to invoke the [[Overlos|Legendary Titan of Immortality]] by distracting the [[Legendary Titans]]. However, [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] decides to stay with Dante as he's completely vulnerable to any threats, and sure enough, two statues in the room turn into [[Undergolem]] Titans, and Zhalia is left to fight them and protect Dante while Lok, [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] and [[Cherit]] go after the Professor. [[File:S1E26 Lindorm Freelancer Hoplite Behemoth.png|thumb|[[Lok Lambert|Lok]]'s [[Titans]] are off to face [[Behemoth]]]] In the invocation room, the Professor summons Behemoth, Tao and [[Araknos]] and begins the ritual to awaken the Legendary Titan from the [[Amulet of Will]]. Shortly after, the team arrives and the Professor reveals that invoking the Legendary Titan of Immortality, though indeed will cure [[Metz]], will also serve to give him immortality to dominate the world. Lok and Sophie decide to invoke their Titans as Araknos is busy with the ritual to control them, and start fighting the Professor, also interrupting his ritual. [[The Professor|Simon]] orders the Legendary Titans to attack them and focus their strength on Lok. Despite their best efforts, it's not long before most of Lok and Sophie's [[Titans]] are overpowered by the Legendary Titans. Tao then sends Lok flying through the wall, and Cherit is able to catch him. In the meanwhile, Zhalia is still fighting the Undergolems and notices that seemingly no [[Seekers|Seeker]] is there to control them. Sophie is then off to fight the Professor by herself, and is able to invoke [[Icarus]] and [[Sabriel]] after using [[Newlife]] on their [[amulets]]. Araknos is still able to control them with its webs; however, to the Professor's surprise, Sophie invokes [[Albion]], who is immune to mind control and is able to free Icarus and Sabriel from the webs. Simon then sends [[Behemoth]] and [[Tao]] after her. To his annoyance, Sophie and her Titans are able to further stall both Legendary Titans for the time being. '''More Than Just a Titan''' [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] then regains consciousness inside of the Professor's personal room, as Cherit had barely enough energy to drop him off through the window. Lok finds his dad's old [[Holotome]] in a desk, alongside the amulet of [[Dendras]], who is able to gain control of enemy Titans with the aid of [[Baselaird]]. Back in the invocation room, [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] is too weak to use any more powers, and [[Sabriel]] is her last Titan remaining. The Professor doesn't want to waste any more time and restarts the ritual. Sophie orders Sabriel to attack Simon but he invokes [[Nordrake]] and [[Dominator]]. [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] is still struggling against the enemy Titans while Dante is unconscious and is out of power to call any more Titans of her own. Still in the Professor's room, Lok has worked out a plan involving Dendras and Baselaird to hopefully save the day. [[File:S1E26 Sophie Sabriel amulet dust.png|thumb|[[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] breaks down as [[Sabriel]]'s amulet fades into dust]] Sophie and Sabriel struggle against the Professor's Titans as the latter is hit with Dominator's spikes, causing her to ignore orders and keep fighting, gradually taking hits and deteriorating while not being sent back to her amulet. Sabriel decides to attack the Professor directly, who strikes her with a sequence of spells that make Sabriel disappear, her [[Amulets|amulet]] being destroyed, seemingly for good. Sophie is angered after her Titan-friend is permanently destroyed, and uses [[Soulburn]] to gain energy to keep fighting at the cost of some of her life force. '''Eathon Lambert's Fate''' In the meanwhile, [[Zhalia Moon|Zhalia]] is completely out of Titans and starts saying her goodbyes to [[Dante Vale|Dante]] as the two [[Undergolem|Undergolems]] move closer. However, Dante suddenly wakes up and invokes a spare [[Caliban]] to fight off the enemies. [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]] again takes on the Professor and his Titans and is soon launched out of the hole Lok made when he was thrown against the wall, only to be caught by him with the use of [[Kipperin]]. They fly back to the invocation room and Lok starts to inquiry [[The Professor|Simon]] about [[Eathon Lambert|his father]]'s whereabouts, just as Dante invokes [[Metagolem]] to finish off the two enemy Titans. Afterwards, he and Zhalia find a [[Eathon the dog|dog named Eathon]] who, via a trained response set by [[Araknos]], invoked the Undergolems. The two then start heading to the invocation room. [[File:S1E26 Personal Guard Professor Eathon.png|thumb|[[The Professor]] corners [[Eathon Lambert|Eathon]] ten years in the past]] [[The Professor]] answers Lok's questions and explains how he chased [[Eathon Lambert]] for years before finally cornering him by a waterfall in South America ten years ago; he continues by saying Eathon knew he could make him say anything he wanted with Araknos' ring, and that Eathon did not want to give up the information on the [[Amulet of Will]]; however, they were interrupted by the completion of the ritual to prepare the [[Amulet of Will]] to be used right before the Professor revealed what Eathon decided to do at the waterfall. Lok sees that he need to stop him from getting to the Amulet of Will, but he's quickly overpowered by the three Legendary Titans who are now free to fight back. He is then saved by Dante's Metagolem, who joins the fight alongside Zhalia. '''The Plan to Save the World''' [[File:S1E26 Dendras Baselaird Kipperin Lok Overlos.png|thumb|[[Lok Lambert|Lok]]'s plan comes to fruition at the last second as he's able to control [[Overlos]]]] [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] states that he has a plan to the team as the Professor invokes [[Overlos|Overlos, the Legendary Titan of Will]]. Lok then invokes [[Dendras]] and [[Baselaird]] while [[Dante Vale|Dante]] also invokes his respective [[Titans]], with Zhalia invoking [[Gar-Ghoul]], as she had taken the amulet for herself instead of giving it to a [[Huntik Foundation]] HQ. The team and their Titans work in unison to distract the Professor's Titans right as Baselaird joins forces with Dendras to control Overlos before [[the Professor]] can request immortality for himself. However, Overlos is seemingly immune to Dendras' ability, making Dante invoke Archwarder to successfully disrupt [[The Professor|Simon]]'s control of the Legendary Titan of Immortality. Lok, now having control of Overlos with Dendras, commands it to open a portal to the [[Spirit World]] and take the remaining Legendary Titans with it. Overlos does as ordered, but not before [[Araknos]] webs the Professor to also drag him to [[Spirit World|Huntik]]. Despite Lok and Dante's best efforts to save him, [[The Professor|Simon Judeau]] does get taken to the Spirit World as the portal closes up. Two days later, the [[Huntik Foundation|Huntik]] team is back at [[Dante Vale's house|Dante's house]] and are surprised by clapping from various friends, including the newly cured [[Metz]], congratulating them for defeating [[the Professor]]. The team praise [[Lok Lambert|Lok]] while he wonders about [[Eathon Lambert|his father]]'s fate, hoping to find him. Nevertheless, summer vacation is almost over, and school starts next Monday for Lok and [[Sophie Casterwill|Sophie]]. ==Trivia== *The original Italian of this episode is ''"E' nato un cercatore"'' (''A Seeker Is Born'' in Italian) which is the name of the first episode of the series in English. *After giving his Caliban Amulet to the Professor in the episode prior, Dante reveals in this episode that he, in fact, always possessed two [[Caliban]] Titans. This is much more clear-cut in the Italian dub where Dante says this outright, while in the English dub he states "Good thing I always carry a spare". == Gallery == {{gallery}} S1E26_Zhalia_King_Basilisk_Undergolem.jpg|[[Zhalia]] and [[King Basilisk]] hold off the two [[Undergolem]] Titans S1E26_Araknos_Tao_Behemoth_ritual.jpg|[[The Professor]] begins his ritual with the Three [[Legendary Titans]] S1E26_Feyone_Sophie_Legendary_Titans.jpg|[[Sophie]] faces [[the Professor]] alone S1E26_Cherit_Dendras_Holotome.jpg|[[Lok]] and [[Cherit]] find [[Eathon]]'s [[Holotome]] and the [[Amulet]] of [[Dendras]] S1E26_Sabriel_broken.jpg|[[Sabriel]] refuses to return to her Amulet S1E26_Professor_castle_Prague.jpg|[[Overlos]] the Legendary Titan of Immortality is summoned S1E26_Ariel_Gar-ghoul_Tao.jpg|[[Ariel]] and [[Gar-Ghoul]] attack [[Tao]] S1E26_Caliban_Behemoth.jpg|[[Caliban]] distracts [[Behemoth]] S1E26 Trying to control Overlos.jpg|[[The Professor]] is adamant that [[Overlos]] will listen only to him S1E26_Archwarder_disruption_pulse.jpg|[[Archwarder]] may just turn the tide S1E26_Lok_Overlos.jpg|[[Lok]] orders [[Overlos]] to return to the [[Spirit World]] and take the three Legendary Titans with him File:S1E26_Dante_Lok_Professor_Arkaknos_portal.jpg|[[Lok]] and [[Dante]] try to save [[the Professor]] but Araknos drags him to the [[Spirit World]] == Titan Profiles == {{Profile |titan = Dendras |attack = 2 |defense = 2 |type = [[Meso-Titan]] Enchanter |size = Medium |ability = Marionettes that shoot fire and ice

Overlos does as ordered, but not before Araknos webs the Professor to also drag him to Huntik. Despite Lok and Dante's best efforts to save him, Simon Judeau does get taken to the Spirit World as the portal closes up.

Two days later, the Huntik team is back at Dante's house and are surprised by clapping from various friends, including the newly cured Metz, congratulating them for defeating the Professor. The team praise Lok while he wonders about his father's fate, hoping to find him. Nevertheless, summer vacation is almost over, and school starts next Monday for Lok and Sophie.
